name: Checkbox
usage: Boolean form fields, permission checkboxes, bulk selection

props.name: indeterminate
props.description:
Partly checked, such as a "select all" box when only some items are selected. Only the appearance changes;
`checked` still decides the value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new checked state.

props.name: children
props.description: Label next to the box; clicking it toggles the box.

members.name: Checkbox.Group
members.summary:
A group of checkboxes built from `options`; its value is the array of the values of the checked options, in
the order of `options`. Use it for a multiple choice among a few options that should all stay visible, such as
permissions or notification channels; with many options, use Select with `multiple`.

props.name: options
props.description: The options: plain values (shown as text) or option objects.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the values of the checked options, in the order of `options`.

props.name: name
props.description: Name of the native checkboxes, for form submission.

types.name: ChoiceOption<V>
types.summary: An option of Checkbox.Group, Radio.Group or Segmented.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: A single checkbox: an option that takes effect when the form is submitted.

examples.name: Group
examples.title: Checkbox group
examples.description: The value of `Checkbox.Group` is an array of the checked options.
